intro.en: Cards, board games, bets and nights out: the vocabulary of play.

tocarle a alguien.nota: Me toca a mí: it's my turn.

texto.en:
**Three words for game.** **Un juego** is the game as such: el ajedrez es **un juego**. **Una partida** is one game of cards, chess or a video game: **echar una partida**. **Un partido** is a match in sport: **un partido** de tenis.

**Cards.** **La baraja española** has forty cards and four suits: **oros**, **copas**, **espadas** and **bastos**. You **barajas**, you **repartes**, you **echas** una carta. The most Spanish game is **el mus**.

**Board games.** On **el tablero** you move **las fichas** after you **tiras el dado**. **El ajedrez**, **las damas**, **el parchís**.

**Turns.** The verb is **tocar**, built like gustar: **¿A quién le toca?** **Me toca a mí.** **Te toca tirar.**

**Tocar** also means to win by luck: **le ha tocado la lotería**; **me tocó** un viaje en un sorteo.

**Rules.** **Seguir las reglas**, **saltarse las reglas**, **hacer trampas**. **Jugar limpio** or **sucio**. **¡Eso no vale!** (that doesn't count!)

**Chance.** **Los juegos de azar**: **la lotería**, **la quiniela** (football pools), **las apuestas**. **Apostar** dinero: **te apuesto** diez euros **a que** gana.

**Children.** **Jugar al escondite** (hide and seek), **a la comba** (skipping), **a las canicas** (marbles); **el columpio** and **el tobogán**.

**Fun.** **Un pasatiempo**; **pasar el rato**; **entretenerse**. **Salir de juerga**, **irse de fiesta**. **Disfrazarse de** pirata for **una fiesta de disfraces**. **Pasárselo en grande.** And at the end of the town festival, **los fuegos artificiales**.

titulo.en: A game of cards after dinner

frases.es: Venga, ¿echamos una partida? Baraja tú, Daniel, que yo reparto.
frases.en: Come on, shall we have a game? You shuffle, Daniel, and I'll deal.

frases.es: Vale, pero esta vez sin trampas, abuela, que te conozco.
frases.en: OK, but this time no cheating, Grandma, I know you.

frases.es: ¡Yo nunca hago trampas! Lo que pasa es que tengo suerte. ¿A quién le toca?
frases.en: I never cheat! The thing is, I'm lucky. Whose turn is it?

frases.es: Me toca a mí. Te apuesto un euro a que esta la gano yo.
frases.en: It's my turn. I bet you a euro that I win this one.
analisis: a que esta la gano yo

frases.es: Hecho. Pero no vale mirar mis cartas en el espejo, ¿eh?
frases.en: Done. But looking at my cards in the mirror doesn't count, eh?

frases.es: Si no hubieras escondido una carta en la manga el domingo, nadie desconfiaría de ti.
frases.en: If you hadn't hidden a card up your sleeve on Sunday, nobody would distrust you.

una partida.en: One game of cards or chess.

pregunta.en: Complete: it's your turn to throw.

toca.en: Tocarle a alguien: to be someone's turn.

tocas.en: The verb stays in the third person, like gustar.

juega.en: The verb for turns is tocar.

pregunta.en: Le ha tocado la lotería means…

It is his turn to buy lottery tickets.en: With a prize, tocar means to win.

pregunta.en: Complete: I bet you that he comes.

que.en: The verb needs a: apostar a que.

de que.en: The verb needs a: apostar a que.

texto.en: He dressed up as a pirate.

explicacion.en: Disfrazarse de: to dress up as.

bloques.frase: Nos lo pasamos en grande en la fiesta de disfraces

traduccion.en: We had a great time at the fancy-dress party.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write the complete rules of a game you know well, so that someone could play it without ever having seen it.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Give your opinion aloud on gambling and online betting among young people.
